page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; no marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword "Resp." at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: fensio in DEUM, ideo dixit,offendit. Item subdit: Qui enim dixit: Non moechaberis, &c. quasi dicat, sicut in eo, quod peccasti non curasti legislatorem: sic nec in alio pec-cato curasses, si occasio peccandi oblata fuisset. Ideo quoad offensam in Deum,Qui offendit in uno,factus est reus omnium.
III. Statuit Chrisma seu extremam un-ctionem papisticam cap. 5.[?]
Resp. Minimè:sed alludit ad unctionem, qua Apostoli ex mandato Domini ungebant ægrotos,&curabantur.Donum erat miracu-lorum,de qua re Marc 6.v.13.
At attribuit huic non solum sanitatem corporis,sed etiam Animæ v.15.[?]
Resp. Imò fidei attribuit,hoc est,fideli orationi utrunque. Oleum symbolum tum erat,nec pro alia re agnoscit Iacobus. Con-firmatur. Nam mox alia exempla adfert effi-cacitatis orationis fidelis.
IV. Non utitur salutatione Apostolica, Gratia vobis,sed profana, Salutem.
Resp. Etiam Apostoli Act.15. sic salutant fratres inter Gentes. Iohannes autem in sua prima epistola nulla utitur salutatione.
V. Eusebius ait esse adulterinam l.2. c.23.[?]
Resp. Ait tamen legi publicè in Ecclesiis: Non omnes igitur habebant illam pro ad-ulterina.
VI. Non facit officium Apostoli. Non enim meminit passionis,resurrectionis,&c. Christi,&eius officij.

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. Doubtful readings: the numerals after "cap." (5), "v." (15), "Act." (15) and "c." (23) are printed in a form where the final digit is hard to separate from a long s or a 3; marked [?]. The first word "fensio" and the word "At" are read with some uncertainty from the scan. Printing errors left as printed: "Deum,Qui" and "Minimè:sed" (missing space). Capital DEVM is printed with V for the vowel and is given as DEUM; the running head SCRIPTVRA is given as SCRIPTURA.
